title: PreflightContract
description: Preflight contract v0.6.6. Generated; do not edit.

selection.description: How the sample was chosen, e.g. 30–70% pass-rate band
selection.title: Selection

ended.description: 0.6.0: how the sampled run ended; stalled = no model call for the stall time (a tool stuck)
ended.title: Ended

concurrency.description: 0.6.1: tasks run at once (the script's workers); in a stalled run at most this many can be stuck
concurrency.title: Concurrency

output_tokens.description: All generated tokens, reasoning included (as OpenAI and Anthropic bill them)
output_tokens.title: Output Tokens

reasoning_tokens.description: The part of output_tokens spent reasoning; not added again
reasoning_tokens.title: Reasoning Tokens

stop_reason.description: cut (0.6.0): stopped with the whole run by a cancel or the run's time limit; never on a stall, where tasks in flight keep no stop reason (0.6.1)
stop_reason.title: Stop Reason

finish_s.description: Seconds from start until the last run ends

start.description: 0.6.0: when the campaign clock starts; start_s and finish_s count from it
start.title: Start

p_by_deadline.description: 0.6.0: probability every run finishes by job.constraints.deadline
p_by_deadline.title: P By Deadline

checkpoint_interval.description: 0.6.0: the checkpoint interval with its interval; checkpoint_interval_s stays the point

CampaignAsha.description: 0.5.0: an ASHA pruning plan and the GPU-hours it saves.
CampaignAsha.title: CampaignAsha

segments.description: Wall-time-capped segments the run splits into
segments.title: Segments

time.description: 0.5.0: this run's wall time, with its interval

start_s.description: 0.5.0: when this run starts, in seconds after the campaign starts, in its lane's slot order

slot.description: 0.6.0: which of its lane's slots runs it, 0-based
slot.title: Slot

reason.description: 0.6.0: why the run is cut or undated, in words
reason.title: Reason

gpu_hours_estimate.description: 0.6.0: this run's GPU-hours with its interval; gpu_hours stays the point

usd_estimate.description: 0.6.0: this run's dollars with its interval; usd stays the point

CampaignQuota.description: 0.5.0: whether the campaign's checkpoints and outputs fit the storage quota.

fits.description: None when the need straddles the quota
fits.title: Fits

CampaignQuota.title: CampaignQuota

expr.description: The literal expression that sets the value, if any
expr.title: Expr

gpu_types.description: Allowed GPU names; empty means any
gpu_types.title: Gpu Types

wall_time_cap_s.description: Scheduler limit per job, e.g. Slurm
wall_time_cap_s.title: Wall Time Cap S

CostBasis.description: Where the run cost's rates come from, so every cost readout can say what it is based on.

price_table.description: Version of B's price table, e.g. 'prices@2026-10-27'
price_table.title: Price Table

currency.description: Rates are USD; fmt() converts for display
currency.title: Currency

includes.description: Line kinds counted in the total
includes.title: Includes

CostBasis.title: CostBasis

CostLine.description: One line of the run cost: a predicted quantity times a rate from the price table.

label_key.description: t() key for the line's label
label_key.title: Label Key

quantity.description: GPU-hours, tokens or GB, with its interval

rate_usd.description: USD per unit; None when not billed
rate_usd.title: Rate Usd

usd.description: quantity x rate; None when not billed in dollars

price_row.description: Id of the price-table row the rate came from
price_row.title: Price Row

CostLine.title: CostLine

quality_scores.description: Column or file holding per-document quality
quality_scores.title: Quality Scores

provider.description: modal, amd_devcloud, local, colab, kaggle, api
provider.title: Provider

image.description: Container image digest the probe ran in
image.title: Image

Estimate.description: One number on screen: a point with an interval, or an honest abstention.

reason.description: Why the engine abstained or extrapolated
reason.title: Reason

rate.description: 0.6.0: cost estimates only, quantity x rate

Estimate.title: Estimate

EstimateRate.description:
0.6.0 (B, Nov 1): how a cost estimate splits into a quantity times a rate, so a client can
re-price it at the visitor's own rate without parsing the reason.

quantity.description: The target holding the quantity, e.g. cost.gpu_hours
quantity.title: Quantity

price_row.description: The price-table row id the rate came from
price_row.title: Price Row

EstimateRate.title: EstimateRate

EvalStats.description: One eval pass, pulled inside the probe window and capped at a few batches.

grad_enabled.description: True when eval ran with autograd on (no no_grad)
grad_enabled.title: Grad Enabled

loader_batches.description: Batches the full eval loader would run, so the pass can be extrapolated
loader_batches.title: Loader Batches

memory_by_batch.description: Allocated bytes after each measured eval batch: growth across batches (outputs kept for metrics) is what makes an eval OOM late in the pass
memory_by_batch.title: Memory By Batch

EvalStats.title: EvalStats

code.description: Stable rule id, e.g. eval.no_grad, data.num_workers_zero
code.title: Code

parent_id.description: Record this one derives from (verify, what-if)
parent_id.title: Parent Id

costs.description: What Preflight itself spent making this record (probes, verify, model calls); never part of the run cost

cost_basis.description: Where the run cost's rates come from (B)

job_cost.description: The run cost breakdown, written by B

made_by.description: 0.6.6: the runner commit and flags that made it (A)

name.description: Canonical name from the spec table, e.g. H100-SXM-80GB, MI300X, L4
name.title: Name

GenerationStats.description: Generation inside the job: RL rollouts, eval sweeps, serving probes.

max_new_tokens.description: The cap the script set, if seen
max_new_tokens.title: Max New Tokens

truncation_rate.description: Share of sequences that hit the cap
truncation_rate.title: Truncation Rate

GenerationStats.title: GenerationStats

skeleton.description: True until probes have measured it
skeleton.title: Skeleton

metric.description: target id or metric key whose rate animates the edge
metric.title: Metric

metrics.description: target ids or probe metric keys this node animates
metrics.title: Metrics

Grid.description:
Predictions precomputed over a knob grid, row-major over `axes`.

point, lo and hi are base64 little-endian float16 holding real / scale;
abstain is a base64 LSB-first bit mask. Grids over MAX_GRID_CELLS cells go
to a sidecar blob. Use encoding.choose_scale() when writing one.

scale.description: Power of two; real value = decoded float16 x scale
scale.title: Scale

fixed.description: Values every knob not on an axis is held at
fixed.title: Fixed

independent_of.description: 0.6.4: knobs this target doesn't depend on (the learning rate, say): the grid answers at any value of them, so a reader holds them nowhere
independent_of.title: Independent Of

sidecar.description: Set when the grid is too large to inline
sidecar.title: Sidecar

Grid.title: Grid

JobCost.description: What the job itself would cost to run in full. Preflight's own spend is `costs`, never here.

total_usd.description: Sum of billed lines, lows and highs added line by line; None on own cluster

gpu_hours.description: Shown first on the user's own cluster

market_equivalent_usd.description: On-demand price of the same GPU-hours, shown grey on an own cluster

at_risk_gpu_hours.description: Money at risk as GPU-hours, shown first on an own cluster (at_risk_usd is then the grey market figure)

at_risk_usd.description: Chance of failure x cost up to the failure point; shown beside the total, never in it

JobCost.title: JobCost

share_token.description: Where the record is read (GET /v1/records/{share_token}) once a skeleton exists
share_token.title: Share Token

message.description: i18n key or plain log line
message.title: Message

record_rev.description: Bumped when the stored record changed; refetch it
record_rev.title: Record Rev

retryable.description: On failed: whether resubmitting may succeed
retryable.title: Retryable

error_code.description: On failed (and 0.6.6: on done with nothing_measured): a stable code in Probe.error_code's families; the UI shows t('error.<code>')
error_code.title: Error Code

import_stop.description: 0.6.5: every probe stopped at an import before its first step (or the job was refused for a package); with runner.free_resend on, one resend of this job today doesn't count against the visitor's daily probe jobs (JobRequest.resend_of names it)
import_stop.title: Import Stop

nothing_measured.description: 0.6.6: on done, no probe reached its first step, so every readout abstains; error_code is the first stopped probe's cause, and the record carries the job.nothing_measured finding. With runner.nothing_measured on, a resend of this job today is free (JobRequest.resend_of), whatever the cause
nothing_measured.title: Nothing Measured

free_resend.description: 0.6.5: on queued, this job is a free resend: it doesn't count against the visitor's daily probe jobs (the daily GPU dollar cap still holds)
free_resend.title: Free Resend

JobRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/jobs (validated by C, executed by A).

source.description: A Source: sample, repo, upload, notebook or template
source.title: Source

lens.description: Optional hint; the script map decides
lens.title: Lens

gpu.description: Requested GPU class; admission control may change it
gpu.title: Gpu

description.description: The visitor's use case, for the guide
description.title: Description

mode.description: plan: map and probe a script (default). probe: one probe at `knobs`. verify: a short fixed-seed run of `knobs` against the record's current settings. sample_more: `tasks` more agent tasks. All but plan take a record source.
mode.title: Mode

knobs.description: probe and verify: the full setting to run at
knobs.title: Knobs

purpose.description: Who asked, for the logbook, e.g. guide.run_probe
purpose.title: Purpose

patch.description: 0.5.0: a unified diff applied to the record's code before a probe or verify job (C's fix loop); code fixes can't be passed as knob overrides
patch.title: Patch

private.description: 0.6.2: the visitor chose private mode; with harness.glimmer_private on, triage runs on Muse Glimmer on Preflight's own GPU instead of Muse Spark Open on Baseten
private.title: Private

resend_of.description: 0.6.5: the job this one sends again (its job id), after it stopped at an import; with runner.free_resend on, once a day per visitor it doesn't count against the daily probe jobs
resend_of.title: Resend Of

extra_packages.description: 0.6.3: PyPI names (no versions or URLs) the probe installs after the code's own requirements; only names on Preflight's list (recorder.requirements.known_packages), wheels only, the image's pinned stack wins. A name off the list fails the job with missing_package.not_allowed (.no_wheels for a package PyPI has no wheels for). Kept on the record's source, so later probes of it install them too
extra_packages.title: Extra Packages

JobRequest.title: JobRequest

KernelStat.description: One row of the profiled probe's kernel table, per optimizer step; B scales it to other GPUs.

name.description: aten op; '(tail) <class> (<n> ops)' rolls up the rest of a class; '(unattributed device time)' is GPU time no op claimed
name.title: Name

device_s.description: Self device time per step (self CPU time on CPU probes)
device_s.title: Device S

flops.description: Per step; counted by PyTorch or estimated
flops.title: Flops

bytes.description: Read plus write traffic per step, estimated
bytes.title: Bytes

KernelStat.title: KernelStat

KernelTable.description: Top KERNEL_ROWS ops by device time, then the tail per class (probe-plan K: 100% within 20%).

steps.description: Profiled steps the rows average over
steps.title: Steps

allow_tf32.description: fp32 matmuls ran as TF32, so B picks the TF32 peak
allow_tf32.title: Allow Tf32

KernelTable.title: KernelTable

probed_range.description: Filled by B from the probes

patch_template.description: Patch template id for code knobs
patch_template.title: Patch Template

group.description: memory, speed, data, model, rl, agent, cluster
group.title: Group

affects.description: Job-map node ids the knob acts on
affects.title: Affects

changes_results.description: True if moving it changes what the model learns (offered only to clear a failure, never as a saving); false if it changes only speed, memory or cost; null if unknown
changes_results.title: Changes Results

impact.description: Change in the objective across the knob's range, normalised to [0, 1]
impact.title: Impact

step_call.description: The call that advances one step, e.g. optimizer.step()
step_call.title: Step Call

MadeBy.description: 0.6.6: what made this record (the re-validation, Nov 3): the runner's commit and the flags on in it.

runner_commit.description: The git commit the runner was deployed from
runner_commit.title: Runner Commit

flags_on.description: Every flag on in the runner when it made the record (flags.json, then its environment's overrides), sorted
flags_on.title: Flags On

MadeBy.title: MadeBy

by_term.description: weights, gradients, optimizer, activations, logits, context, kv_cache, other
by_term.title: By Term

purpose.description: script_map, triage, diagnosis, guide, patch, label, command
purpose.title: Purpose

id.description: name@version, pinned by every grid and estimate that used it
id.title: Id

fixture.description: Illustrative numbers from a fixture, not a fitted model; the UI says so
fixture.title: Fixture

max_positions.description: Longest context the model was built for
max_positions.title: Max Positions

gated_mlp.description: SwiGLU/GeGLU-style MLP with a gate projection
gated_mlp.title: Gated Mlp

tie_embeddings.description: Output head shares the embedding matrix
tie_embeddings.title: Tie Embeddings

quantization.description: Weight format, as engine.memory keys it: nf4, nf4_dq, fp4, fp4_dq, int8, gptq_4bit, gptq_8bit, awq_4bit; none or absent for unquantised
quantization.title: Quantization

shape_source.description: Where the shape fields came from: the code, or the running model
shape_source.title: Shape Source

target_id.description: For custom objectives: the target to optimise
target_id.title: Target Id

description.description: The user's use case in their own words
description.title: Description

Prediction.description: target_id -> Estimate, for one knob setting.
Prediction.title: Prediction

estimates.description: Estimates at the record's current knob values
estimates.title: Estimates

mtti_s.description: Mean time to interrupt, for kind=poisson
mtti_s.title: Mtti S

policy.description: The cluster's rule in words, for kind=policy
policy.title: Policy

knobs.description: Knob values this probe ran at (only those it changed or read)
knobs.title: Knobs

steps.description: Optimizer steps completed; at least 2 for a valid memory peak
steps.title: Steps

error_code.description: Stable code for the failure; the UI shows t('error.<code>') and its hint
error_code.title: Error Code

missing_module.description: 0.6.3: on a missing_package failure, the import the script couldn't find (as Python named it)
missing_module.title: Missing Module

missing_package.description: 0.6.3: the PyPI name that provides missing_module when it's on Preflight's list (an extra package the visitor can add); absent when it isn't, or for a submodule (`a.b`)
missing_package.title: Missing Package

step_log.description: Every optimizer step the probe ran, in order
step_log.title: Step Log

kernels.description: Per-kernel table, current-settings probe only (profiled window)

cache_key.description: sha256 of script, env and knob values
cache_key.title: Cache Key

needs_code.description: True when changing it means editing code, not a flag
needs_code.title: Needs Code

launch.description: Command line that runs the script
launch.title: Launch

risks.description: Problems noticed while reading, in plain words
risks.title: Risks

kind.description: 0.6.3 adds command: a console tool run by name (args holds the whole command; uri is command://<tool>), with runner.command_checkin on
kind.title: Kind

record_ref.description: kind=record: a share token or sample:<id>; the job reuses that record's script, env and data, and writes a new record whose parent_id is it
record_ref.title: Record Ref

commit.description: For repos: the full commit the code was read at
commit.title: Commit

scope.description: 0.6.3: what was read. repo (or absent): the whole source, or its entry point's imports when it's too big to read whole (runner.read_closure). entrypoint (needs entrypoint): only that file, the source's own modules it imports (transitively) and its requirements files, at any size
scope.title: Scope

extra_packages.description: 0.6.3: the job's extra packages (JobRequest.extra_packages), as PyPI names on the list
extra_packages.title: Extra Packages

series.description: Per step: loss, grad_norm, grad_norm_ma, update_to_weight, max_attn_logit, output_logit_norm, loss_scale, lr
series.title: Series

StepSample.description: One optimizer step as the probe saw it, so B fits on every step, not a few summary points.

kind.description: warmup (discarded), timed (no recorder sync points, CUDA events at the step boundary only), phase (synchronised, for the phase split), profiled (profiler attached)
kind.title: Kind

wall_s.description: Step boundary to step boundary, minus eval and checkpoint time
wall_s.title: Wall S

tokens.description: Tokens in the step's batches, padding included
tokens.title: Tokens

padded_len.description: Padded sequence length of the step's batches
padded_len.title: Padded Len

device_used_bytes.description: Whole-device use at the boundary (cudaMemGetInfo): PyTorch plus everything else
device_used_bytes.title: Device Used Bytes

reserved_bytes.description: 0.6.1: the allocator's reserved memory read at the same instant as device_used_bytes, so device_used_bytes - reserved_bytes is the CUDA or ROCm context plus other processes
reserved_bytes.title: Reserved Bytes

StepSample.title: StepSample

by_phase.description: Fractions of a step: data, forward, backward, optimizer, eval, rollout, reference, reward, update, weight_sync, idle
by_phase.title: By Phase

unprofiled.description: Timings come from steps without the profiler attached
unprofiled.title: Unprofiled

id.description: Dotted id, e.g. memory.peak, time.total, cost.total, risk.oom
id.title: Id

readout.description: Which of the four readouts shows it, if any
readout.title: Readout
